action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Look for any client config that might help
# Check for environment variables in the client or server
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -r 'VITE_' /opt/areloria/client/.env* 2>/dev/null | head -10")
print("Env:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check if there's an .env file  
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria/client/.env* 2>/dev/null")
print("Env files:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
